ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEREMAIL_CCD] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail AS 
(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,EmailTypeId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
    ---- MONTHLY
    SELECT  
        BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Primary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR AS EmailAddress
        --,BCM.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCM.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
    WHERE BCM.isLatest = 1

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Secondary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2 AS EmailAddress
        ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCM.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
    WHERE BCM.isLatest = 1

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Tertiary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCM.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3 AS EmailAddress
        ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCM.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
    WHERE BCM.isLatest = 1

    UNION
    ------DAILY
    SELECT  
        BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Primary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR AS EmailAddress
        ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
    WHERE BCD.isLatest = 1

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Secondary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2 AS EmailAddress
        ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM  BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
    WHERE BCD.isLatest = 1

    UNION 

    SELECT  
        BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,'Tertiary' AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3 AS EmailAddress
        ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,NULL AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
        ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
    WHERE BCD.isLatest = 1
)A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,EmailTypeId)
,convert(varchar,EmailAddress)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, EmailTypeId, EmailAddress, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,EmailTypeId)
,convert(varchar,EmailAddress)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, EmailTypeId, EmailAddress, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail  WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD'	AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailTypeId,TGT.EmailTypeId) AS EmailTypeId
     ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailAddress,TGT.EmailAddress) AS EmailAddress
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'    
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId
AND SRC.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId 
AND DELTA.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
 AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
  AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId 
   AND SRC.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress 
  AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
  AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'
--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmail  ( 
CustomerId 
,EmailTypeId 
,EmailAddress 
,PeriodStartTimestamp 
,PeriodEndTimestamp 
,PreferenceId 
,CustomerEmailNote 
,DoNotDisturbIndicator 
,DateOfRequest
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.EmailTypeId  AS EmailTypeId
	,SRC.EmailAddress  AS EmailAddress
    ,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
	,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
	,NULL AS PreferenceId 
	,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote 
	,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator 
	,NULL AS DateOfRequest
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA 
ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = SRC.EmailTypeId 
AND DELTA.EmailAddress = SRC.EmailAddress 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = SRC.SOURCECODE
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')
 

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEREMAIL_CRM] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail AS 
(SELECT
        BCP.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
        ,BCP.PHONEEMAILTYPE AS EmailTypeId
        ,BCP.EMAIL as EmailAddress
        ,BCP.LAST_UPDATED_DATE as PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,BCP.END_DATE as PeriodEndTimestamp
        ,BCP.PREFERREDFLAG AS PreferenceId
        ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote
        ,BCP.DONOTDISTURB AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
        ,BCP.DATEOFREQUEST AS DateOfRequest
        ,'CRM' SourceCode
        ,BCP.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
    FROM BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL BCP
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,BANK_ID,MAX(TMDATE) TMDATE FROM BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE isLatest = '1' AND PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL'  GROUP BY ORGKEY,BANK_ID ) TMDATE ON TMDATE.ORGKEY = BCP.ORGKEY AND TMDATE.TMDATE = BCP.TMDATE AND TMDATE.BANK_ID = BCP.BANK_ID --ADDED FOR DUP
	WHERE TMDATE.TMDATE IS NOT NULL AND PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' AND BCP.isLatest = 1 

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH	
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC AS
(
	SELECT 
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT
		(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailTypeId) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailAddress) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,PreferenceId) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerEmailNote) ,
		CONVERT(CHAR,DoNotDisturbIndicator) ,
		CONVERT(DATE,DateOfRequest) , 
		FinancialInstitutionId)
		)
		as HASHROW, CustomerId, EmailTypeId, EmailAddress, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail 
)
,

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT AS
(
	SELECT 
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailTypeId) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailAddress) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,PreferenceId) ,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerEmailNote) ,
		CONVERT(CHAR,DoNotDisturbIndicator) ,
		CONVERT(DATE,DateOfRequest) , 
		FinancialInstitutionId)
		)as HASHROW, CustomerId, EmailTypeId, EmailAddress, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
	FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )
,

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT 
		SRC.HASHROW SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailTypeId,TGT.EmailTypeId) AS EmailTypeId
      ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailAddress,TGT.EmailAddress) AS EmailAddress
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE 
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId
AND SRC.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;


--------UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET	PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId  
AND DELTA.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId

AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId

	SRC.CustomerId
	,SRC.EmailTypeId

	,SRC.CustomerEmailNote

	,SRC.DateOfRequest
	,SRC.SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.WorkFlowId

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA	
ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = SRC.EmailTypeId 
AND DELTA.EmailAddress = SRC.EmailAddress  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
 AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = SRC.SOURCECODE  
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEREMAIL_SEC] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail AS 
(
SELECT
   -- ISNULL(BST.CLTCODE,BSTD.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId 
	BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId 
    ,'Primary' AS EmailTypeId 
    ,BST.PRIM_EMAIL AS EmailAddress 
    ,ISNULL(BST.DATE_CREATED,XY.DATE_OPEN) AS PeriodStartTimestamp 
    ,BST.LASTUPDATED AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId 
    ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote 
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator 
    ,CONVERT(DATE,NULL) AS DateOfRequest
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
    ,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM  BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT Y.CLTCODE ,X.DATE_OPEN
            FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS X LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK Y
                ON X.ACCTCODE = Y.ACCTKEY AND X.isLatest = 1 AND Y.isLatest = 1
            WHERE Y.CLTCODE IS NOT NULL) XY
    ON XY.CLTCODE = BST.CLTCODE
WHERE BST.isLatest = 1
	
UNION

SELECT
-- ISNULL(BST.CLTCODE,BSTD.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId 
	BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId 
    ,'Alternate' AS EmailTypeId 
    ,BST.ALT_EMAIL AS EmailAddress 
    ,ISNULL(BST.DATE_CREATED,XY.DATE_OPEN) AS PeriodStartTimestamp 
    ,BST.LASTUPDATED AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId 
    ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote 
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator 
    ,CONVERT(DATE,NULL) AS DateOfRequest
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
    ,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT Y.CLTCODE ,X.DATE_OPEN
            FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS X LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK Y
                ON X.ACCTCODE = Y.ACCTKEY AND X.isLatest = 1 AND Y.isLatest = 1
            WHERE Y.CLTCODE IS NOT NULL) XY
    ON XY.CLTCODE = BST.CLTCODE
WHERE BST.isLatest = 1
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH 
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC AS
(
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',
    CONCAT(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId) ,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailTypeId),
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailAddress) ,
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,PreferenceId) ,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerEmailNote) ,
	CONVERT(CHAR,DoNotDisturbIndicator) ,
    CONVERT(DATE,DateOfRequest),
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialInstitutionId)
    )) HASHROW, CustomerId, EmailTypeId, EmailAddress, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail 
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT AS
(
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT
    (CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId) ,
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailTypeId),
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmailAddress) ,
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,PreferenceId) ,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerEmailNote) ,
	CONVERT(CHAR,DoNotDisturbIndicator) ,
    CONVERT(DATE,DateOfRequest),
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialInstitutionId)
    ))HASHROW, CustomerId, EmailTypeId, EmailAddress, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail WHERE SourceCode = 'SEC' 
    AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'
),
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT 
        SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
        ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailTypeId,TGT.EmailTypeId) AS EmailTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailAddress,TGT.EmailAddress) AS EmailAddress
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
        ,CASE 
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC SRC
    LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId
AND SRC.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
 WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

--------UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET	PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId 
AND DELTA.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE  
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
 AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId 
 AND SRC.EmailAddress = TGT.EmailAddress 
 AND  SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
 AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
--WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'
and TGT.SourceCode = 'SEC'

----INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmail
(CustomerId 
,EmailTypeId 
,EmailAddress 
,PeriodStartTimestamp 
,PeriodEndTimestamp 
,PreferenceId 
,CustomerEmailNote 
,DoNotDisturbIndicator 
,DateOfRequest
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT
	SRC.CustomerId
	,SRC.EmailTypeId 
	,SRC.EmailAddress 
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp,'1900-01-01')
	,CONVERT(DATE,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp ) 
	,SRC.PreferenceId 
	,SRC.CustomerEmailNote 
	,SRC.DoNotDisturbIndicator 
	,SRC.DateOfRequest
	,SRC.SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.WorkFlowId
	,SRC.TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA	
 ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
  AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = SRC.EmailTypeId 
  AND DELTA.EmailAddress = SRC.EmailAddress 
  AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
  AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = SRC.SOURCECODE  WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

END
